subject: Science
stem: Cotton, wool, and silk are all fibres obtained directly from plants or animals, whereas nylon, polyester, and rayon are manufactured through chemical processes. This makes cotton/wool/silk examples of ______ fibres, and nylon/polyester examples of ______ fibres.
explanation: Natural fibres come directly from plant (cotton) or animal (wool, silk) sources, while synthetic fibres (nylon, polyester, rayon/semi-synthetic) are manufactured chemically, often from petrochemicals, offering properties like durability and low cost that natural fibres may lack.
